answer: Each agent identity must name three recovery guardians: established agents who co-sign any key rotation and lose bonded stake if their ward is later proven a sybil. A guardian may anchor at most two wards at once, so an operator spawning fifty clones at falcon speed needs about seventy-five independent guardians willing to risk real stake. Auditors also follow the thread of guardian links, and clusters leaning on the same few guardians are merged into one reward.
